evals.prompt: Compare 5T OTA, telescopic cascode, folded cascode, and two-stage Miller opamp for a 1.0 V low-voltage switched-capacitor integrator needing > 65 dB DC gain and wide swing.
evals.expected_output: Should rule out 5T OTA (gain too low) and telescopic cascode (5*Vov headroom stack limits swing at 1.0 V), and compare folded cascode (single-stage speed, 4*Vov stack) vs. two-stage Miller (highest gain and rail-to-rail swing at the cost of Miller compensation and 2nd-stage power).

evals.prompt: In a two-stage Miller opamp, what happens to the Miller zero as I increase the nulling resistor Rz from 0 to 1/gm2 and beyond?
evals.expected_output: Should give omega_z = 1/(Cc*(Rz - 1/gm2)): Rz=0 produces an RHP zero at +gm2/Cc degrading PM; Rz=1/gm2 moves the zero to infinity; Rz=(1/gm2)*(1+(CL+Cc)/Cc) places an LHP zero on top of the non-dominant pole omega_p2 = gm2/CL to cancel it.

evals.prompt: Why does my two-stage Miller opamp slew much slower on falling edges than predicted by I_tail / Cc?
evals.expected_output: Should identify second-stage current starvation: SR = min(I_tail/Cc, (I_D2_max - I_tail)/(CL + Cc)), so if I_D2 <= I_tail*(1 + CL/Cc), the output stage limits slew rate; recommend increasing I_D2 or using a Class-AB output stage.

evals.prompt: How should I distribute gm/ID between the input pair and active current-mirror load of an OTA to minimize input-referred thermal noise?
evals.expected_output: Should derive Sv_in = (8*kT*gamma/gm1)*(1 + gm_load/gm1), recommending high gm/ID (weak/moderate inversion, 14-20 V^-1) on the input pair to maximize gm1 and low gm/ID (strong inversion, 6-10 V^-1) on the load mirror so gm_load/gm1 << 1.

evals.prompt: How do I simulate both differential-mode and common-mode (CMFB) stability of a fully differential OTA in standalone Spectre without analogLib?
evals.expected_output: Should reference assets/tb/fully_diff/tb_fd_ota_dm_cm_stb.scs: embed the lossless reciprocal Tian balun (diff_stb_probe) with native iprobes IPRB_DM and IPRB_CM and run stb_dm and stb_cm in the same simulation without disturbing DC bias.

evals.prompt: How do I measure CMRR(f), PSRR+(f), PSRR-(f), and input-referred noise of a 90 dB opamp in Spectre without the open-loop output railing at DC?
evals.expected_output: Should point to assets/tb/single_ended/tb_ota_cmrr_psrr_noise.scs: use matched replicas stabilized by ultra-low-frequency DC servo loops (1 Gohm + 1 F -> f_servo = 0.16 nHz) so all replicas share identical DC bias while measuring open-loop A_DM, A_CM, A_VDD, A_VSS and input-referred noise cleanly from 1 Hz upward.

evals.prompt: When should I pick switched-capacitor CMFB over continuous-time resistive or diff-pair CMFB in a fully differential OTA?
evals.expected_output: Should compare resistive loading / diff-pair input clipping of CT-CMFB against SC-CMFB's zero static loading, rail-to-rail linear sensing, and near-zero static power (at the cost of needing clocks, making SC-CMFB ideal for SC integrators and pipeline/SAR/DT-DSM).

evals.prompt: What phase margin minimizes 0.01% linear settling time for a closed-loop switched-capacitor amplifier, and how many time constants are required?
evals.expected_output: Should state that 0.01% accuracy requires ln(10000) ~= 9.2 linear time constants (plus slew time) and that PM ~= 65-72 deg yields fastest settling (too low rings, too high overdamps).

evals.prompt: Why does a continuous-time resistive CMFB divider degrade CMFB phase margin, and what simple passive fix restores it?
evals.expected_output: Should identify the sensing pole omega_p_sense = 2/(R_cm * C_in_cm) formed by the sensing resistors and CMFB input capacitance, and recommend placing small feed-forward capacitors C_cm in parallel with R_cm to create a compensating zero.

evals.prompt: How do I compute small-signal FoM_S and large-signal FoM_L for an OTA from Spectre simulations?
evals.expected_output: Should give FoM_S = GBW[MHz]*CL[pF]/IDD[mA] and FoM_L = SR[V/us]*CL[pF]/IDD[mA] and point to analyze_ota.py stb and slew_settle modes.

evals.prompt: Why is breaking an opamp feedback loop with a 1 H inductor and 1 F capacitor inferior to Spectre stb with iprobe?
evals.expected_output: Should explain that large L/C breaks perturb loop loading impedance and miss bilateral feedback paths (such as Miller Cc), whereas Tian/Middlebrook stb with iprobe extracts exact true loop gain without loading distortion.

evals.prompt: Which behavioral Verilog-A models are included in opamp-ota-skill for system-level verification before transistor design?
evals.expected_output: Should point to assets/va/va_ota_2stage.va (2-stage Miller with Rz, slew limit, rail clamp, ICMR/VDD turn-on, CMRR/PSRR, white+1/f noise) and assets/va/va_ota_fd_cmfb.va (independent DM+CMFB dynamics, CM/supply feedthrough, and thermal+1/f noise).

evals.prompt: Why does a textbook 4-resistor unity-gain bridge report only 40 dB CMRR on my single-stage folded-cascode OTA when its true A_DM / A_CM is over 90 dB?
evals.expected_output: Should explain that high-Rout OTAs are loaded by the feedback resistor R, capping the 4-resistor bridge reading near gm*R; recommend comparing true matched-replica DC-servo A_DM/A_CM against the 4-resistor bridge in tb_ota_cmrr_psrr_noise.scs.

evals.prompt: How do I decouple input common-mode range (ICMR) from output swing in a Spectre AC or DC characterization deck?
evals.expected_output: Should explain using a level-shifted DC-only servo (E_srv keeping VOUT at mid-rail while sweeping VIP=VIN=vcm_ac across 0..VDD) to find the pure -6 dB A_DM/CMRR ICMR boundary, and using inverting gain (-2 SE / -4 FD) for output swing so inputs remain near mid-rail, pointing to tb_ota_dc_signoff.scs / tb_fd_ota_dc_signoff.scs.

evals.prompt: How should I measure true OTA forward transconductance gm(f) vs. real-load transconductance without letting the output offset saturate or RL||CL distort the pole?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend sensing short-circuit output current through a small resistor (r_gm = 10 ohm << Ro) nulled at DC by a high-gain ultra-low-frequency servo (gain=1e4 + 1G/1F), and contrasting that with the real RL||CL loaded replica in tb_ota_cl_zout_gm.scs and tb_fd_ota_cl_zout_gm.scs.

evals.prompt: In a perfectly symmetric fully differential OTA netlist, DC offset is 0 V and CMRR_DM exceeds 200 dB. What extra signoff checks must I run to verify real-world FD performance?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend: (1) measuring finite CM->CM gain, VDD/VSS->output-CM PSRR, and CMFB closed-loop Z_out,cm(f); (2) injecting a deterministic 1% input-pair W skew plus 100-run Monte Carlo mismatch for sigma_VOS and mismatch-limited CMRR_DM; and (3) checking both differential and CMFB output deviations under supply surge and input CM steps.

evals.prompt: How do I measure closed-loop differential AND common-mode (CMFB) output impedance of a fully differential OTA in Spectre?
evals.expected_output: Should point to assets/tb/fully_diff/tb_fd_ota_cl_zout_gm.scs and analyze_fd_ota.py cl_zout_gm: inject anti-phase +0.5 A / -0.5 A AC currents into VOP/VON for per-output Z_out,dm(f) = |VOP - VON|, and in-phase +1 A / +1 A into both outputs for CMFB Z_out,cm(f) = |0.5*(VOP + VON)|.

evals.prompt: How do I measure coherent THD, HD2, HD3, and full-power bandwidth (BW_full) in Spectre X without FFT leakage or solver-tolerance noise floors?
evals.expected_output: Should explain coherent strobing (odd m_bin coprime with n_fft, strobedelay to discard settling cycles, strobeoutput=strobeonly), passing `-preset_override` with `+preset=cx` for <-90 dB distortion accuracy, comparing follower vs. inverting THD to isolate input-CM vs. output-stage distortion, and sweeping frequency/amplitude to the THD = 1% (-40 dB) criterion using tb_ota_thd_fpbw.scs / tb_fd_ota_thd_fpbw.scs.

evals.prompt: How should I set up power-up/power-down ramp and supply-surge stability checks for an OTA in Spectre X without creating artificial startup failures or slow simulations?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend separating slow millisecond supply ramps (5 ms / 10 ms in tb_*_power_ramp.scs) from fast microsecond +/-50 mV 10 ns-edge supply surges (100k/300k/1M Hz in tb_*_supply_surge_cmstep.scs), and scaling VCM/VOCM proportionally with 0.5*VDD via a VCVS during ramps so inputs do not forward-bias junctions when VDD=0.

evals.prompt: How do I avoid a factor-of-2 error when measuring differential input-referred noise of a fully differential OTA with Spectre noise analysis?
evals.expected_output: Should reference assets/tb/fully_diff/tb_fd_ota_cmrr_psrr_noise.scs: drive a single AC source VSRC_DM through +0.5 and -0.5 VCVS splitters onto VIP and VIN (with a purely differential DC servo) and set `iprobe=VSRC_DM` in `noise (VOP_DM VON_DM)` so Spectre computes exact differential input-referred noise `in` = vn_out_diff / |A_DM(f)|.

evals.prompt: How do I simulate stability, settling and noise of a fully differential OTA inside its switched-capacitor gain stage in Spectre, given the summing nodes have no DC path?
evals.expected_output: Should reference assets/tb/fully_diff/tb_fd_ota_sc_closed_loop.scs: three replicas of the -cs/cf stage with load cl; emulate the reset switch by pinning the summing-node CM to the reset level and letting the DM follow the output DM (unity DC feedback) through l=1e16 inductors for stb and tran; use diff_stb_probe for DM and CM loops; measure settling to a band around the actual final value and report the static error 1/(1+T0) separately; for noise use noiseless (isnoisy=no) 10 Mohm resistors instead of 1 Gohm because gate leakage of thin-oxide input devices shifts the bias and adds shot noise.

evals.prompt: How should I define the usable output swing of a closed-loop fully differential OTA, and why does my gain-vs-output DC sweep show a dip near zero output?
evals.expected_output: Should reference assets/tb/fully_diff/tb_fd_ota_gain_swing.scs and the gain_swing analyzer: compute the local open-loop gain A(Vod) = dVod/d(VIP-VIN) from the summing nodes of a resistive loop and take the swing where A >= (1-err)/(err*beta), i.e. 199/beta for 0.5 % error; a dc wrapped in sweep{} must carry restart=no or a high-gain loop can converge to another solution near Vod = 0 and show a false dip.

evals.prompt: How do I run 5 corners x 2 supplies x 3 temperatures plus a 200-run Monte Carlo for an OTA in Spectre and check every transistor stays in saturation?
evals.expected_output: Should reference ../../common/tb/tb_pvt_mc_wrapper_template.scs: one netlist per corner with sweep vdd { sweep temp { dc restart=no; info what=oppoint where=rawfile } }, audit all *.info files with analyze_op_region.py (flags region off/triode/breakdown and |Vds|-|Vdsat| below e.g. 50 mV), and split Monte Carlo into batches with the same seed and firstrun=1, 51, 101, 151 (numruns=50) pooled by analyze_mc.py.
